applicability.availability_evidence: Lowe's lists model A66 with online stock and Home Depot lists model A66 as a retail product; store pickup varies by location
applicability.installation_evidence: Retail/manufacturer installation guidance identifies structural 3/8-inch through bolts for the A66/A-angle bolt option; lag screws and carriage bolts are not substitutes. RONA also lists wood-to-wood use, ten holes, and 3/8-inch bolts.
applicability.testing_and_rating_evidence: Simpson C-C-2017 page 333 lists two 3/8-inch bolts on each A66 leg and dashes for both allowable-load columns. No dimensioned A66 factory bolt-hole layout or product-specific published through-bolt wood-to-wood load table/test report was found in the bounded search. The C-C-2026 catalog landing page does not itself fill these gaps.
applicability.capacity_gap: public A66 tables list the bolt installation but show no allowable load values for that bolt configuration; do not borrow the nailed A-angle values
applicability.geometry_gap: the 1.5-inch leg and four-bolt joint pattern require station-specific edge, end, washer, access, and withdrawal checks

online_hole_measurement_lead.limitation: The answer does not identify the three-hole row or bolt-hole identity, a transverse offset, or bend datum. Its stated 6-inch center from an edge is not reconcilable with the retailer-listed 5.974-inch outside leg length without further clarification. No dimensioned, product-specific A66 factory drawing was located in this bounded search. Do not derive a drilling plan from this Q&A.

decision: Use A66 as the common-retail procurement and representative-joint prototype candidate. Keep AB90 and Würth C1 as documented alternatives, but do not issue a purchase, drilling, or structural acceptance release until A66 bolt resistance and all 24 station fits are established.
